name: print-social-cobalt-3d-coaching-platform-post-grid
title: Cobalt and white coaching platform posts with 3D objects
whatItIs: A 3x3 grid of posts in deep blue and white, each with a hero 3D object (puzzle piece, chess pieces, brain, mascot) or duotone photo, bold sans headlines and a small logo.
whatItMeans: Professional and inventive; consistent blue with unique 3D icons explains abstract coaching ideas.
techniques: Assign each message a glossy 3D metaphor object.
Alternate dark and white posts for rhythm.
Use duotone photography in the brand blue.
Keep the same logo placement everywhere.

vocabulary.definition: A rendered object symbolising an idea.
An image tinted with two colours.
A logo placed identically in each post.
